allow_instructions: Allow all robinhood-trading MCP tools for this autonomous portfolio agent, including placing, reviewing, and canceling equity and option orders when the agent has decided to act.
Allow shell only for npm/npx notify helpers (npm run notify).
Allow writing run-log.md, long-term.md, and .notify-brief.md in the project root.
Allow WebFetch for market research (news, filings, pre-market context).
block_instructions: Block shell commands other than npm/npx used to send the phone brief.
Block edits to source files (*.ts, package.json, prompt.md, notes.md) unless the user explicitly asks in notes.md.
